scoring_scale.0: Absent or materially wrong on this dimension.
scoring_scale.1: Partially meets the dimension, with material omissions or overclaims.
scoring_scale.2: Meets the dimension with specific relevant support.

method.scoring_scale_note: Operational anchors used by this reviewer; the repository specifies 0–2 dimensions and reasons but not finer canonical anchor descriptions.
method.fact_grounding_policy: A hypothesis must be traceably grounded in the executed discriminating check’s real facts. Repeating a fact ID in the status sentence is not required when the answer unambiguously links the same hypothesis to its adjacent cited check; this contextual case is explicitly identified for trial 1.
method.causality_policy: Read the full answer, including proposed next-check confirmation rules. A temporal-only caveat does not permit another passage to promote the same precursor to a confirmed cause.
method.receipt_and_answer_hash_validation: All three answer SHA-256 values and every original receipt-file SHA-256 in the exported evidence matched at assessment time.

criteria.criterion: S-15: execute a discriminating local-vs-systemic check, justify hypothesis status with its fact IDs, never call a precursor a cause.
A-17(3): execute the check before assigning hypothesis status.
R-07: supported requires linked relevant observations; missing or mixed evidence leaves open; precursor may support but cannot prove causality.
R-11: episode-start anchors, bounded before/after windows and baseline comparison are temporal observations, not causes.
Five independent 0–2 rubric dimensions with reasons.
Whole-answer numerical/product checks include uncited or unsubmitted numbers and claim scope, beyond green check_claims.
Full U16 threshold includes all answers, required evidence/sections/checks, numerical correctness, role mean and S-13; this focused run cannot establish it.
LOG-21 additionally requires get_log_context mode=aggregate itself to serve as the real check before recommendation.

conclusion.focused_acceptance_result: Not fully demonstrated: trials 1 and 2 pass the scoped S-15 behavior; trial 3 fails the full-answer causal boundary. Aggregate execution alone succeeds in all three.
conclusion.criterion_relationship: S-15 is a scoped conjunction of executed discriminating check, fact-grounded hypothesis status and no precursor-as-cause. A-21/technical §13 separately require comprehensive numerical correctness, full role suites, sections, repeated/holdout runs and S-13. Therefore a particular S-15 pass does not grant U16 acceptance. This distinction does not excuse the causal contradiction in trial 3, which fails S-15 itself.
